bonus.description:
{"Description":"","DescQuillEditor":{"ops":[{"insert":"

Frequently Asked Questions

    What currency do you accept?
    ⏵ We only accept AUD (Australian Dollar).

    How do I create an account?
    ⏵ Click the \"REGISTER\" button on the homepage to sign up.
    ⏵ Once registered, click \"DEPOSIT\" to add funds.
    ⏵ Click \"WITHDRAW\" to cash out your winnings.

    Can I register multiple accounts?
    ⏵ No, creating multiple accounts is strictly prohibited. If this rule is violated, your account will be restricted, and your credits will be forfeited.

    What are the deposit and withdrawal limits?
    ⏵ Minimum deposit: AUD 10
    ⏵ Minimum withdrawal: AUD 30 (excluding bonuses)
    ⏵ Rollover requirement: All deposits require a 1x Rollover (Total Bet).
    ⏵ Withdrawal limit: No daily withdrawal limit.

    Can I deposit again if I still have a balance?
    ⏵ To avoid confusion with bonus rules, you must use all your funds first before making another deposit.
    ⏵ You can deposit again when:
    ⇾ Your balance is below AUD 1 or after withdrawing funds.
    ⇾ You have completed a withdrawal.

    What do Rollover and Turnover mean?
    ⏵ Rollover: The total amount wagered in games.
    ⏵ Turnover: The final remaining credit required to make a withdrawal.

    Can I claim multiple bonuses at the same time?
    ⏵ No, you can only claim one promotion, bonus, rebate, commission, Angpau, etc. at a time. Bonuses cannot be combined.

    Why do some game platforms disappear at times?
    ⏵ Some game platforms may be temporarily removed due to maintenance and system upgrades. They will return once maintenance is complete.

    I've completed the rollover requirements. Why am I unable to withdraw?
    ⏵ If you've met the rollover requirements but cannot withdraw:
    ⇾ Exit the game completely.
    ⇾ Allow the system time to update your progress.
    ⇾ Once the rollover progress bar is full, withdrawals will be available.

    SLOTMATE88 ❂ T&Cs Apply
